user.title: Connect to Haier AC (local)
user.description: Enter the air conditioner's LAN IP address. Default port 56800 (first-generation eSDK Wi-Fi module). Nothing goes to the cloud.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the air conditioner: check the IP, make sure it is on the same network as Home Assistant, and that no other client is holding the connection

abort.already_configured: This air conditioner is already configured
